headline: Council approved East Terrace parking changes with increased ticket fees; discussed art show, Jambo statue, and FY2028 budget.
summary: Staff updated members on the FY2028 budget, and Council will hear staff presentations on December 16th. The SNOW art show runs November 23rd through January 28th, and an Artists Market is set for December 6th. Members remembered former member John Killacky, who passed on November 2nd.

plain_text:
PAGE 1 
 
SOUTH BURLINGTON  
PUBLIC ART COMMITTEE MEETING 
Tuesday, November 18, 2026 
The South Burlington PUBLIC ART COMMITTEE held a meeting on Tuesday, November 18, 2026, at 
5:30 p.m. at 180 Market Street in Room 301, and by remote participation.  
Members Present: Sebastian Ryder (Chair), Amanda Holland, Isaac Cates (Vice-Chair), Karen 
Liamos, Thomas Lindley, Penne Tompkins, Bryce Myers, Mark Behr, Ilona Blanchard (Staff 
Liaison, non-voting), Tim Barritt (City Council Liaison, non-voting)   
Members Not Present: Sophia Babbitt, Michele Bailey (Vermont Art Council, non-voting) 
 
Also in Attendance: None. 
 
1. Convene Meeting: The meeting was convened at 5:35 p.m. by Sebastian. 
• Ilona reviewed emergency procedures. 
• Karen was identified as the minute taker for the meeting. 
• The agenda was reviewed.  A motion to approve the agenda as submitted was 
made by Karen and seconded by Amanda.  Motion was approved.  
 
2. Opportunity for Public Comment 
• No members of the public were present 
• Sebastian mentioned that she recently met with a member of the public who 
wanted to become more engaged with the group and will attend a future meeting. 
 
3. Minutes from the October 20, 2025 meeting were reviewed and a minor correction 
was made. The amended minutes were approved following a motion by Penne that 
was seconded by Amanda.   
 
4. Updates: 
  Chair (Sebastian Ryder):   
• Sebastian provided an overview of the “Join or Die” movie and tabling event that 
followed, which she and Penne attended.  The movie is about the health of 
democracy and the need for civic engagement.  She suggested that in future years the 
event be held in the spring before the deadline to submit names for volunteering for 
city committees. 
• Name tags for committee members were discussed and will be made to wear at 
future events, as well as a table runner to inform the public that they have a public 
art committee.
Public Art Committee Meeting | Page 2 
  Staff (Ilona Blanchard): 
• Ilona provided an update on the maintenance for the Infinite Hue installation at 
Jaycee Park, to address the scratches in the sculpture previously noted by Penne.  
• SB3C (South Burlington City Center Collaborative) is sponsoring an event, Shop 
Local, Learn Local on November 19th, from 8:30-9:30AM featuring a panel 
discussion with four local small business owners.  This will be held in the 
Community Room at the Library. 
• South Burlington Recreation and Parks is holding an 802 Spotlight event featuring 
Blane Newton, CIO of Beta Technologies also on November 19th, at 5:30PM in 
the City Center Auditorium. 
• Ilona announced that the north end of Garden Street will open to thru traffic to 
Midas Drive on November 23rd. 
  
  Council (Tim Berritt): 
• Tim expressed thanks to all members of the community who came out and voted. 
• Attended the SBBA (South Burlington Business Association) at OnLogic where 
the focus was on cyber security. 
• Council set February 7th as date for a Necessity Hearing on right of way piece of 
land to extend walking/bike path for land connecting South Pointe and South 
Village neighborhoods. 
• Parking changes were approved by Council for East Terrace with increased fees  
for tickets. 
  
  Appointees and Working Group 
•  Penne announced that she and Amanda would attending the Master Plan Advisory 
Group and would update the group at the next meeting. 
 
5. South Burlington Public Art Gallery 
• The upcoming art show, SNOW: A Winter Holiday and New Year Exhibit, will be 
on display November 23rd - January 28th. It will feature multiple artists. Maedeh 
Asgharpour, Curator has already sent out calls to artists and requests to participate 
have been coming in. 
• Related to this, there will be an Artists Market on December 6th, from 11AM - 
6PM with 15-20 vendors selling artwork and possibly crafts.  This will be held in 
the Senior Center, Clerks Office and Hallway at City Center. 
• Mark, Thomas, Karen and Penne volunteered to work the event to help set-up, 
clean up, and table with information about the Public Art Committee. 
 
6. Events - Jambo Dedication 
• Ilona provided a summary of the dedication event of the donated Jambo statue 
now in place at Veteran’s Park.  A plaque for the statue is in the works. 
 
7. FY 2028 City Budget
Public Art Committee Meeting | Page 3 
•  llona updated the group on the FY2028 budgeting process for City Council. 
Council will hear presentations from Staff on December 16th. 
• Related to the Public Art Committee, the primary budget items to be included 
include the curator stipend and funding for the CIP at current levels. 
 
8. John Killacky Remembrance 
• Members who knew John Killacky, a former Public Art Committee member, who 
passed on November 2nd, remembered John’s contributions.  Among many other 
contributions to the state, John worked on the initial creation of the RFP for the 
Cultural Art Plan for this Committee. 
 
9. Other Business 
• Isaac proposed the idea of sponsoring a community art movie series in the City 
Center auditorium. Options for this idea were discussed.  Ilona will set up a 
meeting with Library staff to discuss further and include Thomas and Isaac, and if 
available, Sebastian. 
• The meeting was adjourned at 7:12 p.m. The next meeting will be on Tuesday, 
December 15th at 5:30 p.m. 
 
 
Respectfully Submitted, 
 
Karen Liamos
